title: Statistical mechanics of linear classification on hierarchical tree data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep networks owe much of their success to their ability to exploit the structure in data, from the grammar of language to the multi-scale organization of images. Yet, many statistical mechanics approaches to structured data rely on Gaussian equivalence, whose assumptions can fail when a few latent variables influence all input coordinates. In this work, we take a step beyond this setting with a simple setup, in which a linear classifier is trained to infer the root of the classical broadcast process on a tree from its $N$ leaves. Despite this simplicity, the data already display non-Gaussian statistics along the direction carrying the label, as well as strong finite-size effects. By retaining the exact law along this direction and approximating the transverse fluctuations as Gaussian, we obtain a finite-depth replica theory that accurately describes the measured learning curves. translated_title: 层次树状数据上线性分类的统计力学
translated_abstract: 深度网络的成功很大程度上归功于其利用数据结构的能力，从语言的语法到图像的多尺度组织。然而，许多针对结构化数据的统计力学方法依赖于高斯等价性，当少数潜变量影响所有输入坐标时，该假设可能会失效。在这项工作中，我们通过一个简单的设置超越了这一框架：训练一个线性分类器，从经典树上广播过程的 N 个叶子节点推断其根节点。尽管设置简单，数据在携带标签的方向上已经呈现出非高斯统计特性，以及强烈的有限尺寸效应。通过保留该方向上的精确分布律，并将横向涨落近似为高斯分布，我们得到了一个有限深度的副本理论，能够准确描述实测的学习曲线。在大深度且正则化足够弱的情况下，我们……
tldr: 本文提出一个有限深度的副本理论，通过精确保留标签方向的非高斯统计并将横向涨落近似为高斯，准确刻画了线性分类器从树状广播过程叶子推断根节点的学习曲线，突破了传统高斯等价方法的局限。
en_tdlr: This work develops a finite-depth replica theory for linear classification on hierarchical tree data, which goes beyond the Gaussian equivalence assumption by exactly retaining the non-Gaussian statistics along the label direction and accurately describes the measured learning curves.
